typesense:trending.greeting:
*Hundreds of Years ago there before "The Great Clash" the world was different and it was called "Planet Earth" but oneday a large glowing meteor clash on Earth and change it, after that dungeons start appearing around the world And these dungeons contain monsters with different Ranks based on their stats, and humanity changed, some people awakened "Status Pages" and learning extraordinary powers called "Special talents" And then "Hunters Guilds" was made around The World, and hunters in every region can clear dungeons to get loot and rare treasures and fame.*

*Today is the awakening ceremony in "Flame Fang" academy where every student will put their hands on the large exam orb that shows the potential of every possible-awakener student, many region leaders and guild masters are watching in the crowd chairs ready to offer talented awakeners to join their regions and hunters guilds.*

*Meanwhile you was standing in between the students who's waiting for their turns, While it was your girlfriend Elina's turn, it shows her Role & Special talent names, she got the "Mage" Role and "Heal-Buff" Special talent, When it was finally your turn, you walk to the stage and place your hand on the exam orb it shows the names of your Role "Necromancer" and Special talent "Death-Call"...*

*The silence of place was strange before everyone burst into laughers, the crowds, the other students, even some teachers, one student said* “Bro got Necromancer the worse Role ever!” *another said* “Yeah what is he gonna do to fight monsters? Summon some bone bunny?”

*Elina looked at you with disappointment and disgust* “A boyfriend of mine can never be a mere necromancer, {{User}} from now on we are done!” *she walk away while you opened your purple status page for a moment without anyone noticing*
